description: Paths AI and search crawlers requested that returned 404/410, paths blocked by robots or 403, and whether the machine-facing files (robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, markdown) were fetched at all. This is the only signal that turns 'what machines wanted' into a task: create, redirect, unblock or publish llms.txt. Read-only. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_crawler_gaps
title: Pages crawlers asked for that do not exist
